answer: Require every identity to post a refundable stake-bond, hard as jade, before it can bid: the bond locks in a public forge where any peer can slash it on proof of duplicate behavior. A quartz-clear audit trail ties each stake to one verified work receipt, so clones share one bond's fate — one fraud burns them all. One honest agent risks a single small bond; a thousand-clone farm must lock a thousand bonds, and one bad apple forfeits the whole orchard.
